text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Matikanetannhauser's debut
race is
finally here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for my debut!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've been sculpting my body for
today—look at
this form!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
My parents said they're going to be
cheering me
on from their restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Okay! I'm gonna blast this race open
and take
home the win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that promise made, we head
enthusiastically
to the waiting room!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we'...
Yeah, let's give it all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's still some time before the race. I
figure we might as well review our
strategy, but when I turn
around to talk
to Matikanetannhauser...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I went into the wrong room, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, I always seem to mess something
up
whenever I get serious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's certainly motivated, though a bit

unfocused.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I just need to refocus and do
my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Matikanetannhauser's debut
race begins!
